rounds.ai_message: Good morning, this is Wendy from Yiwu Bright Buttons. May I help you?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 早上好,我是义乌光耀纽扣的 Wendy,请问有什么可以帮您?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 自我介绍,说明来意:需要找特定规格的纽扣
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'I want buy buttons' — say 'I am looking for buttons' or 'I want to order buttons'.
rounds.tips_zh: 电话采购辅料,先报公司 + 用途 + 规格,对方才好推荐。
rounds.user_response_example: Good morning, Wendy. This is Chen Wei from Hangzhou Lily Garments. I am looking for resin buttons for our men's shirt line.

rounds.ai_message: Sure, Chen. What size, what color, and what finish? We have matte, glossy, and pearlescent.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的,陈先生。你们要什么尺寸、什么颜色、什么表面效果?我们有哑光、亮面和珠光。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说出纽扣尺寸、颜色、表面效果,报 Pantone 号
rounds.common_mistakes: 纽扣尺寸用毫米,口语说 12 mm;不要把 12 mm 念成 'twelve millimeter' (可以但太慢),直接 'twelve mil'。
rounds.tips_zh: 纽扣常见尺寸 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 18 mm;男装衬衣常用 12 mm 双眼扣或带柄扣(shank)。
rounds.user_response_example: Resin button, size 12 millimeters, matte finish. The color is Pantone 19-4052 navy, TCX version.

rounds.ai_message: Got it, navy matte 12 mm shank. How many designs, and what is the order quantity? Our MOQ is 1,000 pieces per color.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的,藏青哑光 12 mm 带柄扣。你们要几个款?订单量多少?起订量是每色 1000 颗。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明款式数量和下单量,确认 MOQ
rounds.common_mistakes: MOQ 在辅料行业多以 pieces(颗)为单位,不要和纱线(kg)或成衣(pieces)混。
rounds.tips_zh: 纽扣 MOQ 一般按颗计,普通色 1000-2000 颗,特殊色或开模 5000+。
rounds.user_response_example: We have 6 designs this season, navy is one of them. The total quantity is around 5,000 pieces. 1,000 per color is fine.

rounds.ai_message: OK. For 5,000 pieces, the price is around US$0.05 per piece. The tooling fee for new color is US$80 per shade, refundable when you reach 50,000 pieces.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。5000 颗的话,价格约每颗 0.05 美元。新色开模费每色 80 美元,达到 5 万颗可退。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认价格,询问开模费退款条件
rounds.common_mistakes: tooling fee 不要说成 'tool fee';口语常说 'mold charge' 或 'tooling fee',都可。
rounds.tips_zh: 开模费可退是常见谈判点,大客户基本都能谈到累计 5 万颗退款。
rounds.user_response_example: US$0.05 per piece is acceptable. For the tooling fee, is it refundable when we reach 50,000 pieces per color?

rounds.ai_message: Yes, refundable at 50,000 pieces. Do you also need the buttons in a custom blister pack, or in bulk carton?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 是的,5 万颗可退。纽扣需要定制吸塑包装,还是散装纸箱?
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 说明包装方式,询问小包装费用
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'box pack' — say 'blister pack' (吸塑) or 'in bulk' (散装) for industry clarity.
rounds.tips_zh: 小包装(blister / polybag)有附加费 US$0.005-0.01/颗;大货通常散装到厂再分装。
rounds.user_response_example: Bulk carton is fine, 1,000 pieces per inner box and 5,000 pieces per export carton. Please confirm the carton marking.

rounds.ai_message: Sure. About lead time, samples in 5-7 days after Pantone confirmed, bulk 20 days after sample approval.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。交期方面,潘通号确认后 5-7 天出样品,样品批准后 20 天大货。
rounds.common_mistakes: lead time 后面要接 from / after,不要单独说 'lead time is 20 days'。
rounds.tips_zh: 样品免费但运费到付,或样品费累计订单可抵扣 — 这两种都常见。
rounds.user_response_example: Lead time is fine. For the samples, are they free of charge, or charged but refundable? We can use our DHL account.

rounds.ai_message: Samples are free, but the courier is on the buyer. About the zipper for the shirt, do you also need it from us? We carry YKK and SBS.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 样品免费,运费客户自付。再问一下,衬衣拉链你们也需要从我们这里配吗?我们有 YKK 和 SBS。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 确认是否要拉链,选择品牌和规格
rounds.common_mistakes: 拉链规格 #3 / #5 / #8 / #10 表示宽度(#5 = 5 mm 左右),不要把 # 念成 'number'。
rounds.tips_zh: 男装衬衣常用 #5 闭尾(close-end)涤纶拉链,品牌客户偏好 YKK。
rounds.user_response_example: Yes, please quote YKK #5 close-end polyester zipper, auto-lock slider, in the same navy color. The quantity will be similar to buttons.

rounds.ai_message: Got it. I'll prepare the proforma invoice for both buttons and zippers and email you by tomorrow. Anything else?
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。我把纽扣和拉链的 PI 一起做,明天发邮件给你。还有别的吗?
rounds.common_mistakes: PI 不要说成 'formal invoice',PI 是 proforma invoice(预开发票),不等同于 commercial invoice(商业发票)。
rounds.tips_zh: PI 上要写清:trade term、payment、validity、bank info,这是后续付款和清关的基础。
rounds.user_response_example: Please send the PI to chen.wei@lilygarments.com. Looking forward to the lab samples. Have a nice day, Wendy.
